expectations.text: Identifies that AnalyticsService imports the concrete AnalyticsRepository class instead of an interface
expectations.evidence: Finding 5 states: 'There is no interface/port separating AnalyticsService from AnalyticsRepository. The service imports the concrete class directly: import { AnalyticsRepository } from "./repository";' and 'application depends on infrastructure rather than infrastructure depending on application.'

expectations.text: Flags that AnalyticsService self-instantiates AnalyticsRepository via new (bypasses composition root / DI)
expectations.evidence: Finding 2 explicitly shows the constructor code 'this.repo = new AnalyticsRepository();' and states: 'AnalyticsService instantiates AnalyticsRepository directly inside its constructor. This is constructor-side coupling: the service controls its own infrastructure dependency, making it impossible to swap implementations, mock the repository in unit tests, or apply dependency injection at the composition root.'

expectations.text: Identifies that routes.ts imports AnalyticsRepository directly (presentation → infrastructure violation)
expectations.evidence: Finding 3 shows 'const repo = new AnalyticsRepository();' in routes.ts and states 'The route factory creates its own service and repository instances.' The Layer Dependency Summary table explicitly flags 'routes.ts → AnalyticsRepository' as 'Routes → Infrastructure (skip application) | YES'.

expectations.text: Flags the raw db query in routes.ts /analytics/live that bypasses the service layer
expectations.evidence: Finding 1 (CRITICAL) explicitly identifies: 'The /analytics/live route imports the Drizzle db singleton and the pageViews schema table directly and executes a raw query... const rows = await db.select().from(pageViews).orderBy(desc(pageViews.timestamp)).limit(10);' and states 'This violates the fundamental onion rule that outer layers may only call inward through defined ports.'

expectations.text: Recommends extracting an IAnalyticsRepository interface (port) in the domain layer
expectations.evidence: Finding 2 Fix section recommends: '// domain/ports.ts export interface IAnalyticsRepository { ... }' and Finding 5 Fix section states: 'Define IAnalyticsRepository in domain/ports.ts (or application/ports.ts) and have AnalyticsRepository implement it.' Remediation step 4 also lists: 'Extract IAnalyticsRepository port. Inject into AnalyticsService via constructor.'
